source.rights: Review full selected files and exceptions before use; source attribution is not a code license.

sampling.rule: Freeze a metadata-only deterministic sample before source-body access. No redraw, replacement, or result-conditioned selection. Original paths, seed and revision are withheld.

representation.boundaries: Column-zero ATX headings outside fences; exact contiguous original text; explicit anchors only. Raw dynamic text is inert. No rendering or includes.
representation.source_locator: Resolve only in the same-source fixed manifest. Leading / maps to src/. Relative paths normalize without escaping src/. Exact .html changes to .md; extensionless leaf adds .md. No directory/index guess, implicit anchor, external URL, or fallback.
representation.citation: https://github.com/<repository>/blob/<revision>/<canonical-path>#L<start>-L<end>. Placeholder repository in this derivative changes citation byte lengths; mapping logic is unchanged.

tasks.authoring: Author and reviewer do not inspect retrieval output before freeze. Record intended action, necessary factual conditions/exceptions, exact supporting raw spans, complete sufficient parent-set alternatives, and eligibility. One pre-evaluation factual correction round. This describes operational role separation, not external independence.
tasks.exclusions: Keep every planned slot and reason; do not replace invalid anchors. Keep otherwise valid budget-infeasible tasks.

scoring.meaning: Complete support-pack coverage, not generated-answer correctness. Verify exact raw spans, reviewed obligations, canonical adapter binding and full payload serialization before set containment.
scoring.denominators: Report eligible and all planned tasks, with excluded slots counted as failure in planned sensitivity.
scoring.diagnostic: BM25 top8 is descriptive only and never enters the primary screen.

runtime.cold_definition: Parent before process spawn to parent receipt of durable cold-output event. Child waits for ACK before warm work. Includes startup, raw reads, parse, graph where applicable, index, query, pack, and output write.
runtime.limits: Fresh process on shared host; no cold OS cache or dedicated hardware claim. Acquisition, rights review and authoring are upstream costs. Export/toy times cannot reproduce the original corpus timing.
runtime.failure_policy: Primary execution failure means INCONCLUSIVE; record failed work and missing/censored time honestly. No performance-driven retry or post-result tuning.

publication: Template and code do not grant data acquisition, evaluation, publication, deployment, or additional copyright permissions.
